title: Clamp an end stop bracket onto a DIN rail against a terminal block and tighten screw
instruction: Slide the end stop bracket along the DIN rail flush against the terminal block, hold it snug, and tighten the clamping screw with the screwdriver, then return the screwdriver and clear both arms.
context: Electricians (SOC 47-2111; 762,600 US jobs, BLS OEWS May 2023) assemble and maintain industrial control panels and motor control centers. Under NFPA 70 (NEC Article 409) and UL 508A standards, DIN-rail mounted terminal strips must be secured with screw-clamped end brackets (Phoenix Contact CLIPFIX 35-5) to prevent block creep, terminal separation, and severed jumper bridges. The electrician slides the bracket against the terminal stack, holds the stack compressed, and torques the M4 screw to draw the steel foot tight against the rail underside.
setup: Station table with a slotted 35 x 7.5 mm steel top-hat DIN rail (length 250 mm, axis along Y) bolted at x 26 cm, y 0 cm. A stack of four 5.2 mm terminal blocks (Phoenix Contact UT 2.5) sits centered at y 0 cm, backed by a fixed right stop at y +1.6 cm. A screw-clamp end bracket (Phoenix Contact CLIPFIX 35-5, width 9.5 mm, captive M4 screw) sits loose at y -8 cm. A 3.5 mm slotted torque screwdriver (Wera Kraftform preset to 0.4 N*m) rests in a tool rest at x 22 cm, y 18 cm.
scoring: Score 1.0 when the end bracket is seated flush against the terminal stack (gap <= 0.5 mm), the M4 clamping screw is tightened until the 0.4 N*m torque driver clicks (advance >= 0.6 mm, torque >= 0.4 N*m), resisting an active 20 N lateral proof push with dial-gauge slip <= 0.5 mm, screwdriver returned to rest, both arms clear >= 20 mm, and stationary for 1.0 s. Partial credit: 0.75 for clamped and proof-held but hands or tool unreleased; 0.50 for flush with screwdriver engaged in slot; 0.25 for bracket slid forward. Score 0 if stack displaced > 5 mm, bracket derailed, or proof slip > 2 mm.
reset_notes: Place the terminal stack at y 0 cm backed by the stop. Place the loose end bracket at y -8 cm with screw backed out 1 turn. Place the screwdriver in its tool rest at x 22 cm, y 18 cm.
fidelity: Slotted 35x7.5 mm steel DIN rail (length 250 mm). Four UT 2.5 terminal blocks. CLIPFIX 35-5 end bracket with sliding clamp foot and M4 screw joint. 3.5 mm slotted screwdriver with slot engagement. Active 20 N lateral proof push. Full contact physics and gripper clearance checks.
